extraction_notes: The PDF identifies the device as Si2333DS, Vishay Siliconix, P-Channel 12-V (D-S) MOSFET; the job-file MPN is SI2333DS-T1-GE3.
P-channel voltage and current values are stored as magnitudes; signed source test conditions are retained in the condition strings.
PDF page 3 is explicitly headed Typical Characteristics 25 °C unless otherwise noted. Output, transfer, and capacitance curves are target-specific and were digitized only at visible graph locations.
The output curve labeled V_GS = 5 V through 2.5 V is clipped by the 20 A plot limit and was omitted rather than inventing points.
